answer: An operator running 101 keys thus burns for 101 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the orchard salt is published after the reef checkpoint, the garden audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 121 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
